items.html: Maurits, identical twin of Mark Jonkman, represented Netherlands at all age groups up to the Under-23 level in the ICC European Championships. He bagged three wickets on debut against Bermuda in Rotterdam in 2008, and joined the ICC European Academy the same year in India. He is working hard at becoming a solid opening bowler.
